entities.summary: Johan Rutger Gunnarsson was a Swedish musician, bass guitarist, guitarist, arranger and producer. He was closely associated with the pop group ABBA. Rutger Gunnarsson was a composers & musicians from Linköping Cathedral Congregation (1946-02-12, Linköping Cathedral Congregation–2015-04-30).
